activity.notes: William Marshal, 1st Earl of Pembroke (c.1146–14 May 1219), a knight and military commander, was selected as regent of the Kingdom of England for the minor Henry III on 11 November 1216. The role lasted until Marshal's death in May 1219; end boundary is intentionally year-granularity rather than asserting an unverified exact administrative handover. Do not create 'England under William Marshal' as a new polity; the King remained Henry III.
